title: Endpoint and Data Protection: framework mapping
frameworks: PCI DSS v4.0.1, PCI Security Standards Council
NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5, Security and Privacy Controls

EDP-01: Company and personal devices that access company data are enrolled in MDM and recorded in the asset inventory.
MDM device list reconciled to the HR roster and asset register
EDP-02: Full-disk encryption is enforced on all laptops and mobile devices, with recovery keys escrowed centrally.
MDM compliance report showing encryption status per device
EDP-03: EDR or anti-malware runs on every endpoint, updates automatically and sends alerts to a monitored queue.
EDR console coverage report and a sample alert with its ticket
EDP-04: Endpoint DLP rules block or alert on copying sensitive data to unapproved destinations.
DLP policy export and a sample incident log
EDP-05: Personal devices use a managed work profile or app protection policy, and the BYOD policy is acknowledged.
BYOD policy, signed acknowledgements and app protection policy settings
EDP-06: USB storage is blocked or restricted to encrypted, approved devices, and autorun is disabled.
Device control policy export and the exception list
EDP-07: Email and cloud storage DLP detect and control external sharing of sensitive data.
Email DLP and sharing policy settings with a sample alert
EDP-08: Endpoints follow a hardened configuration baseline with OS and application patching enforced.
Baseline document and a patch compliance report
EDP-09: Data in transit uses TLS 1.2 or higher (TLS 1.3 preferred), and cryptographic keys are managed under a documented policy.
Cryptography policy, TLS scan output and key management settings
EDP-10: Lost or retired devices are remotely locked or wiped, and media is sanitised before reuse or disposal.
Wipe logs, disposal certificates and the lost device procedure
EDP-11: Information is classified and labelled so DLP rules can act on the label.
EDP-12: A host-based firewall is enabled and managed on every end-user device.
Firewall configuration profile and compliance report
